correctness.rationale: TARGET route: proof of explicit C=5, eps0=min{1,lambda/10} with (delta,1) hence (delta,2) over common refinement W plus infinite-compacta extension was verified for shift arithmetic (2K0 round trip + 3K0 sweep = 5K0; delta<lambda/2; Lemma 6.1 finite-p-length convergence and 5-lemma need no pfd) and artifact re-execution passes with Part B honestly labeled ILLUSTRATION ONLY (inequality engine, not spectral transfer). Two essential inferences fail. (A) Lemma 2.2/Section 3 existence: for every thickened-overlap vertex w=(i,j) with W_{i,j}=U^0_i cap V^0_j != empty in host Z, a pair (x_w,y_w) in R with block membership is asserted under K0<rho, but thickened overlap (radius rho=0.1 fixed) does not imply an R-pair (proximity eps~0.002): the triangle bound gives dist~eps+2rho>rho, so many W-vertices have no R-pair and the diameter chase has no carrier. Restricting to R-matched vertices breaks the claimed pullback convergence to PH(VR) (surjectivity without fiber-contractibility/goodness, never proved for arbitrary Borel partitions). (B) Page scope: Prop 6.4/Thm 6.5 give (delta,1) for pullback diagrams over the same K=Delta_W, not for the original E(J_P),E(J_Q) over Delta_P,Delta_Q with different nerves; refinement invariance (Pennig-Torras Sec.7) yields at best page 2, so the headline (delta,1) for the originals is not established. The defects change hypotheses/conclusions and need new refinement/fiber machinery, not a bounded presentation fix.

originality.rationale: TARGET route with no fallback: three-form fused search (literal GH join-model MVSS threshold; Pennig-Torras Prop 6.4/Thm 6.5 equivalent; broader GH MVSS/VR stability dominance) returned 20 items with full per-provider coverage and no partial failure. Full body of the nearest prior (Pennig-Torras 2024, arXiv 2105.03307v2, 33pp, offsets 0-116k of 122k) was inspected: Prop 6.4/Thm 6.5 are abstract same-nerve (eps,K)-carrier transfers with no GH input, mesh mu, explicit C=5, eps0 threshold, or infinite-compacta clause; Example 6.6 assumes a nerve isomorphism plus per-piece Hausdorff closeness and concludes d1_I<=eps with no constants/threshold/GH/mesh; Sec.7 different-cover results give (eps,2) under local vanishing, not the submitted GH VR join-model threshold. No broader census, classification, or table implies the explicit threshold; the combination is not a mechanical corollary or renaming.

value.rationale: The headline, if proved, would be independently retrievable: an explicit GH stability threshold (C=5, eps0 from fixed covering data) for join-model persistent Mayer-Vietoris spectral sequences of Vietoris-Rips filtrations, persisting without pointwise finite-dimensionality, directly advances the stability program posed in Pennig-Torras (blowup stability, different-cover comparison, VR join model avoiding overlap bounds). It is not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny unmotivated gain, or unexplained enumeration; the object and invariant were motivated before computation and a future researcher could need the precise cutoff. Value is judged separately from the correctness failure above.
